action: Customers should change email and important account passwords, use unique passwords with a password manager, enable two-step verification and watch for unsolicited messages, as Dutch police advise.
date_note: Date of the Dutch police announcement; the data theft itself is dated September by the police.
exec: Dutch police link attempted violence to stolen Revolut customer data, a case where a data breach carried physical risk.
plain: Dutch police say a number of attempted violent acts in the Netherlands, which they link to data stolen from Revolut customers, were foiled. Several arrests were made and a criminal investigation has started.

sources.name: NL Times (ANP): Dutch police foil potential violent attacks linked to Revolut data breach

summary: Dutch police say unauthorized third parties took data of hundreds of European Revolut customers in September, including several in the Netherlands; NL Times (ANP) reports police put the Dutch figure at 36. Police link foiled attempted violent acts in The Hague and Amsterdam to the theft; multiple arrests were made, with French and Belgian suspects among them. Revolut told ANP it is cooperating fully with Dutch police and has contacted affected Dutch customers.

evidence.quote: including 36 Dutch customers, according to police.

title: Dutch police link foiled violence attempts to Revolut customer data theft

validation.note: Dutch police press release (primary, last update 19 November) read in full; it gives no count of Dutch victims or arrests. Security.nl reports the same statement. NL Times (ANP, 19 November) says police put the Dutch figure at 36 and quotes a Revolut spokesperson; the 36 is not on the police page.

review.note: Compared title, summary, date 19 Nov, September theft, hundreds of European customers, Den Haag/Amsterdam, multiple arrests, French/Belgian suspects, Revolut contact and advice against the Politie release and Security.nl; no figures beyond the source
